key_insight: Decouple safety and performance guidance in a diffusion-based planner: use cost‑conditioned trajectory generation to enforce variable cost limits reliably, and apply reward gradients only to boost performance without violating those constraints.
problem_solved: Offline safe RL policies must adapt at deployment to episode-varying or intra-episode changing safety budgets; prior diffusion guidance that mixes reward and cost gradients can fail to satisfy cost limits reliably.
method: Treat adaptive safe trajectory generation as sampling from a constrained distribution and implement cost‑conditioned diffusion sampling to respect a specified cost limit.
Apply a separate reward-gradient guidance step (after or alongside cost‑conditioned sampling) to improve task performance while preserving the constraint satisfaction provided by the cost condition.
Design the planner to accept changing cost budgets at deployment (per episode or intra-episode) without retraining the policy offline.
impact: Provides a practical, flexible planner for offline safe RL that preserves safety under varying budgets while still improving reward — useful for real-world applications (robotics, autonomous driving) where safety limits change at run time.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing decoupled stages: cost‑conditioned diffusion sampler → constraint‑satisfying trajectory → reward‑gradient refinement.
Graphic of sampling distributions: constrained (cost‑conditioned) vs unconstrained, illustrating safe region enforced by cost condition.
Performance vs safety plots across varying cost limits, showing improved reward while maintaining cost compliance compared to joint‑gradient baselines.
Example trajectories in an environment (e.g., obstacle course) contrasting trajectories from prior methods that violate cost limits with the proposed method that stays within budget.
paper_title: A decoupled diffusion planner that adapts to changing cost limits by using cost-conditioned generation for safety and reward gradients for performance
paper_authors: Rufeng Chen, Zhaofan Zhang, Zhejiang Yang, Hechang Chen, Sihong Xie
